sections.heading: Purpose
sections.body: This policy sets out how employees request and take paid time off. It applies to all full-time and part-time employees on Ivoyant payroll.

sections.heading: Entitlement
sections.body: Employees receive 18 days of earned leave per calendar year. Earned leave accrues monthly at 1.5 days. Employees also receive 8 days of casual leave and 6 days of sick leave.

sections.heading: Requesting leave
sections.body: Leave must be requested in the HRMS at least 7 days in advance. Requests are approved by the reporting manager. Sick leave can be applied on return to work.

sections.heading: Carry forward
sections.body: Up to 10 days of unused earned leave carry forward to the next year. Casual and sick leave lapse at year end.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: This policy covers employees working from locations other than an Ivoyant office. It does not change employment terms or compensation.

sections.heading: Eligibility
sections.body: Employees who have completed probation may work remotely up to 2 days a week. Roles that require on-site presence are excluded.

sections.heading: Working hours
sections.body: Remote employees must be reachable during core hours of 11:00 to 16:00 IST. Calendars must reflect working location.

sections.heading: Equipment
sections.body: Ivoyant provides a laptop and headset. Employees are responsible for a reliable internet connection.

sections.heading: Principles
sections.body: Employees act with integrity, respect and fairness in all dealings. Everyone is responsible for raising concerns early.

sections.heading: Conflicts of interest
sections.body: Employees must disclose any outside business interest that may conflict with their role. Disclosures are reviewed by People and Legal.

sections.heading: Gifts
sections.body: Gifts above ₹5,000 in value must be declared. Cash gifts must never be accepted.

sections.heading: Reporting concerns
sections.body: Concerns can be raised with a manager, HR or the ethics inbox. Retaliation against anyone raising a concern is prohibited.

sections.heading: Access
sections.body: Access to systems is granted on a least-privilege basis. Access is reviewed every 6 months by system owners.

sections.heading: Passwords
sections.body: Passwords must be at least 12 characters. Multi-factor authentication is required for email and code repositories.

sections.heading: Devices
sections.body: Company laptops must use full-disk encryption. Screens must lock after 10 minutes of inactivity.

sections.heading: Incidents
sections.body: Suspected incidents must be reported to the security channel within 1 hour.

sections.heading: Approval
sections.body: Business travel must be approved by the reporting manager before booking. International travel also needs approval from the department head.

sections.heading: Bookings
sections.body: Flights and hotels are booked through the travel desk. Economy class is used for flights under 6 hours.

sections.heading: Allowances
sections.body: A daily allowance of ₹2,500 covers meals within India. Receipts are required for all expenses above ₹500.

sections.heading: Claims
sections.body: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of travel. Approved claims are reimbursed with the next payroll.

sections.heading: Commitment
sections.body: Ivoyant is committed to a workplace free from sexual harassment. This policy follows the POSH Act, 2013.

sections.heading: Internal committee
sections.body: An Internal Committee handles complaints. The committee is chaired by a senior woman employee and includes an external member.

sections.heading: Complaints
sections.body: Complaints can be filed within 3 months of an incident. Inquiries are completed within 90 days.

sections.heading: Training
sections.body: All employees complete awareness training every year.

sections.heading: Issue
sections.body: Assets are issued on joining and recorded against the employee in the HRMS.

sections.heading: Care
sections.body: Employees must keep assets secure and report loss or damage within 24 hours.

sections.heading: Return
sections.body: Assets must be returned on the last working day. Unreturned assets are recovered from the final settlement.

sections.heading: Maternity
sections.body: Birthing parents receive 26 weeks of paid leave.

sections.heading: Paternity
sections.body: Non-birthing parents receive 4 weeks of paid leave, taken within 6 months of the birth or adoption.

sections.heading: Adoption
sections.body: Adoptive parents receive the same leave as birthing or non-birthing parents.

sections.heading: Guidance
sections.body: Employees dress in business casual at the office. Client visits require formal attire.
